lawRefs: 36 M.R.S. § 5111 sub-§§ 1-F, 2-F, 3-F (rates) and income tax surcharge enacted by P.L. 2025, ch. 650, Pt. N
header.notes: sha256 is of the canonical JSON body (JSON.stringify of the file without `header`). Hand-transcribed; sha256 is of the canonical body. From MRS '2026 Individual Income Tax Rates' (revised 2026-05-20) and the revised 2026 Form 1040ES-ME (July 2026). 2026 law change: a new 2% income tax surcharge applies to Maine taxable income above $1,000,000 (single), $750,000 (MFS) or $1,500,000 (MFJ and HOH), indexed from 2027. Because the threshold varies by filing status it is encoded here as a fourth bracket at 9.15% (7.15% + 2%) and NOT as a `surtax` entry. The same law set the 2026 standard deduction at $15,700 single/MFS, $23,550 HOH, $31,400 MFJ (Tax Foundation's January 2026 table shows the superseded $8,350/$16,700). The standard (or itemized) deduction phases out for Maine AGI above $102,250 (single/MFS, per the 2026 Form 1040ES-ME; HOH and MFJ thresholds are about 1.5x and 2x) over a range of about $75,000 (about $112,500 HOH, $150,000 MFJ). Personal exemption $5,300 for taxpayer and spouse only (dependents get a credit instead), phased out above Maine AGI $341,000 (single). Additional standard deduction for age 65+/blind follows IRC § 63(c)(3): $2,050 unmarried, $1,650 per married spouse. Social Security and Railroad Retirement benefits are fully exempt. Pension income deduction: up to $49,824 per person for 2026 (the maximum annual Social Security benefit at full retirement age) of pension, 401(k)/403(b)/457 and IRA distributions, any age, REDUCED by Social Security and Railroad Retirement benefits the recipient received; military retirement fully exempt.

flags.brackets: top 9.15% bracket is the 7.15% rate plus the 2026 2% surcharge (thresholds 1,000,000 single / 750,000 MFS / 1,500,000 MFJ and HOH); no separate surtax entry
flags.standardDeduction: simplified: maximum shown; phases out over Maine AGI 102,250-177,250 single/MFS (about 153,375-265,875 HOH, 204,500-354,500 MFJ)
flags.personalExemption: simplified: phases out above Maine AGI 341,000 (single); taxpayer and spouse only, dependents receive a credit
flags.seniorExtraDeduction: simplified: 2,050 if unmarried; 1,650 per spouse if married
flags.retirementIncomeExclusion: simplified: 49,824 cap is reduced dollar-for-dollar by the person's Social Security/Railroad Retirement benefits
